**Finding: compliant (preferred level) — no redline proposed.**

The licence architecture in § 13, read with § 24, meets every preferred element:

- **Affiliates** — § 13.1 grants access rights to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf"; § 13.2 extends the paid-up licence to "Customer and its Affiliates." No written-notice gate is required, so this exceeds the fallback.
- **Contractors** — covered in the § 13.1 grant and via "permit contractors to support that material" in § 13.2.
- **Paid-up perpetual / irrevocable** — § 13.2 grants a "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence," and § 14.3 confirms it reaches Vendor Technology embedded in Deliverables.
- **Subscription revocation limited to uncured material breach** — § 13.3 bars revocation or suspension except during "a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure." A document-wide search for suspension rights found no competing at-will suspension provision.
- **Transfer to successors** — § 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor under § 24.1 (merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets, without Vendor consent), and § 24.4 prevents Vendor from terminating or repricing on a Customer change of control.

The § 13.4 restrictions are narrow and carve out authorized security testing and use of Customer Data and output, so they do not undercut the granted scope.
